items.title: Akamai (AKAM) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of cloud technology company Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ:AKAM) jumped 15.1% in the pre-market session after the company announced a seven-year agreement with Anthropic featuring $11.6 billion in contractual commitments to provide cloud computing capacity.
